scripts.build: npm run build -w types && npm run build -w execution
scripts.cf:deploy:pipeline: node scripts/cf-with-env.mjs npx wrangler deploy --config workers/pipeline/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy:api: node scripts/cf-with-env.mjs npx wrangler deploy --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:deploy:workers: npm run cf:deploy:pipeline && npm run cf:deploy:api
scripts.cf:d1:local: node scripts/cf-with-env.mjs npx wrangler d1 execute publisher-db --local --file=schema.sql --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.cf:d1:remote: node scripts/cf-with-env.mjs npx wrangler d1 execute publisher-db --remote --file=schema.sql --config workers/api/wrangler.jsonc
